Record Class PurchaseResponse

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
ca.refundr.highspring.domain.purchase.PurchaseResponse
Record Components:
id - purchase id
userId - shopper who owns this purchase
subtotal - sum of line totals after discounts, before tax
salesTax - tax charged on subtotal
total - subtotal + salesTax — amount paid
taxRate - sales-tax rate stored with the purchase
createdAt - when the purchase was recorded (UTC)
items - line items frozen at checkout time
public record PurchaseResponse(UUID id, UUID userId, BigDecimal subtotal, BigDecimal salesTax, BigDecimal total, BigDecimal taxRate, Instant createdAt, List<PurchaseResponse.PurchaseItemResponse> items) extends Record
A finished purchase with money totals after discounts and sales tax.
